_comment: S3 bucket policy — agrisync-raw-backup-ap-south-2 (the NEW cross-region
backup/vault bucket for agrisync-raw-ap-south-1).
spec: FINAL_SERVER_AUTHORITATIVE_EXECUTION_PLAN (raw-bucket-backup-recovery)
runbook: _COFOUNDER/runbooks/raw-bucket-backup-recovery.md
AUTHORED, NOT APPLIED. This bucket does not exist yet — see
create-backup-bucket.sh, which must run BEFORE this policy can attach.
TLS-only, matching aws/raw/bucket-policy.json's Phase-1 pattern (round-1
review finding C1 on the PRIMARY bucket applies equally here: do not add
an encryption-header-deny statement without the same CloudTrail-verified
proof that finding required — none has been done for this new bucket,
so none is authored here either).
DELIBERATELY ALSO DENIES DeleteObjectVersion AND PutLifecycleConfiguration
bucket-wide, with NO break-glass exception carved out here (unlike the
source bucket's deny-delete addition, which does carve one out for
genuine DPDP erasure). This bucket's entire purpose is to be the copy
nothing can touch. If a real erasure ever needs to remove a specific
farmer's data from THIS bucket too (DPDP erasure requests apply to
backups, not just primary storage), that is a deliberate, logged,
founder-approved exception process — see the runbook's 'Erasure reaching
the backup copy' section — not a standing IAM grant.
APPLY (founder only, after create-backup-bucket.sh):
aws s3api put-bucket-policy --bucket agrisync-raw-backup-ap-south-2 --policy file://backup-bucket-policy.json --region ap-south-2
